title: Maps on the complement of V(I) extend to maps from I^n G (Noetherian scheme)
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, i.e. a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] whose underlying space is quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent and $\mathcal G$ a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals; regard each stalk $\mathcal I_x$ as an ideal of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk](1), put $V(\mathcal I)=\{x\in X:\mathcal I_x\neq\mathcal O_{X,x}\}$ and $U=X\setminus V(\mathcal I)$. For $n\ge1$ let $\mathcal I^n\mathcal G\subseteq\mathcal G$ be as in [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module](0) (the image of the multiplication map $\mathcal I^n\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G\to\mathcal G$, $\mathcal I^1=\mathcal I$, $\mathcal I^{n+1}=\mathcal I\cdot\mathcal I^n$), and $\mathcal I^0\mathcal G=\mathcal G$. Then $V(\mathcal I)$ is closed, $\mathcal I|_U=\mathcal O_U$ and hence $(\mathcal I^n\mathcal G)|_U=\mathcal G|_U$ for all $n$; and the maps $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal I^n\mathcal G,\mathcal F)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_U}(\mathcal G|_U,\mathcal F|_U)$, $\chi\mapsto\chi|_U$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], which are compatible with the maps $\operatorname{Hom}(\mathcal I^n\mathcal G,\mathcal F)\to\operatorname{Hom}(\mathcal I^{n+1}\mathcal G,\mathcal F)$ given by restriction along the inclusions $\mathcal I^{n+1}\mathcal G\subseteq\mathcal I^n\mathcal G$, induce an isomorphism of abelian groups $\varinjlim_n\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal I^n\mathcal G,\mathcal F)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_U}(\mathcal G|_U,\mathcal F|_U)$ (colimit over $n\ge0$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]). In particular, for every $\mathcal O_U$-linear $\psi:\mathcal G|_U\to\mathcal F|_U$ there are $n\ge0$ and an $\mathcal O_X$-linear $\chi:\mathcal I^n\mathcal G\to\mathcal F$ with $\chi|_U=\psi$. (For $\mathcal G=\mathcal O_X$: $\varinjlim_n\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal I^n,\mathcal F)\cong\Gamma(U,\mathcal F)$.)
